originalTitle: Show HN: Koi.rest – watch some fish and regain your balance
content: Hi there. My name is Paul. I’m a developer, an explorer and I’ve got ADHD. As of the beginning of August, I’m also unemployed. This last part, along with everything else this past year, has caused me a great deal of stress. While our balcony zen garden project is yet to be completed, I had an idea to create a virtual one that everyone can use. It's an idea that, unfortunately, I’ve been postponing for a while now, mostly because I have no fucking idea how to do it as I don’t know JavaScript, and I don't have the capacity to learn it right now. So I let perfect be the enemy of good and, well... just kept the idea to myself. Then I said "fuck it" and used AI to make the thing I really wanted to make. I realized I didn't want "perfect". I wanted "good enough". I tweaked, added, removed, drew, researched, questioned, tested... I just wasn't the one coding it. So now, instead of occupying my brain, it now lives on the internet for others to enjoy. Yes, there’s something noble about making something entirely on your own, but what good is an idea that just sits in my head? So here I am. I made the thing. The weird, little, quiet koi pond. The silly project of passion. The little corner of the internet to let strangers watch fish quietly, together. I hope this pond helps you as much as it helped me.
chineseTitle: Show HN：Koi.rest – 观赏鱼并恢复平衡
chineseContent: 你好呀。我叫保罗。我是一名开发人员、一名探索者，而且我患有多动症。截至八月初，我也失业了。最后一部分以及去年的其他所有事情给我带来了很大的压力。虽然我们的阳台禅宗花园项目尚未完成，但我有一个想法，那就是创建一个每个人都可以使用的虚拟花园。不幸的是，这个想法我已经推迟了一段时间了，主要是因为我根本不知道该怎么做，因为我不懂 JavaScript，而且我现在没有能力学习它。所以我让完美成为优秀的敌人，好吧……只是把这个想法留给自己。然后我说“去他妈的”并使用人工智能来制作我真正想做的东西。我意识到我并不想要“完美”。我想要“足够好”。我调整、添加、删除、绘制、研究、质疑、测试……我只是不是编码的人。所以现在，它不再占据我的大脑，而是存在于互联网上供其他人享用。是的，完全靠自己创造一些东西是很崇高的，但是一个只存在于我脑海中的想法有什么好处呢？所以我在这里。我做了那件事。奇怪的、小而安静的锦鲤池。愚蠢的激情项目。互联网的小角落，让陌生人一起静静地看鱼。我希望这个池塘对你有帮助，就像它对我有帮助一样。
